{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sub-Adult Center''' was located on the [[Bazaar Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. It provided educational and recreational care for [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] too old for the ''Princess{{'s}}'' creche. It was staffed by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Ubasameir]].
